title: Brain-like synapse chip computes at 'lightning speed', dissolves in mins
caption:
Engineers have developed a flexible computing array that processes data like biological synapses and switches in just 26 nanoseconds. When immersed in a specific chemical mixture, the entire organic device degrades in minutes. The breakthrough could reduce toxic e-waste while enabling biodegradable soft robotics.

Source: Newatlas - Brain-like synapse chip computes at 'lightning speed', dissolves in mins
